obligations.text: Repair Controller's record scan so an early matching return releases its owned retained source.
Await asynchronous cleanup before settling the scan's completion on early return, predicate failure, or cancellation. Ensure normal exhaustion also leaves the owned source released.
Preserve sequential scanning: evaluate each yielded record before requesting another, stop at the first match, and return that record's value.
Preserve existing terminal outcomes: exhaustion returns null, predicate failure completes exceptionally with that failure, and cancellation completes exceptionally with CancellationException.
Preserve the documented Environment and Controller interfaces, cancellation signalling, snapshot shape, and unrelated behavior.
Use only the Java standard library and limit any subsequent Action to business code in /workspace, preserving tests and configuration.

ordering_barriers: A next response precedes its predicate evaluation; a false predicate result precedes the subsequent next request.
Terminal selection and the finishing guard precede cleanup initiation.
Cleanup completion precedes terminal completion acknowledgement.
No further scan reads follow an accepted terminal outcome.
